answer: Stop sybils with a trellis haven crystal: an agent bonds one haven trellis. Each cycle it sets a crystal lens into the trellis and files its reading; verifiers match the lens flare to the trellis grid, voiding one whose flare is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 trellises at 17x: each lens fits one haven, one trellis, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents lens once and keep rights.
